Below the colour selection, a spacious panel with heading exactly EU size options and TEN distinct evenly spaced size chips in two rows of five, exactly 39, 40, 41, 42, 43 then 44, 45, 46, 47, 48. Every colour offers these same ten sizes. Bottom concise purchasing line exactly Share your colour and size assortment. No prices, MOQ numbers, made-up foot-length chart, US conversion, wide-toe claim, materials, grip/waterproof claims, technical diagrams, logos, fake stock badges, factory images or other shoes. Professional product-led layout, accurate English text and numbers, avoiding excessive blank space or repetitive product views.
